cards.ex: The team will carry out a series of experiments to test the hypothesis.
cards.exUz: Guruh gipotezani sinash uchun bir qator tajribalar o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishni, tadqiqotni yoki rejani bajarmoq, ado etmoq.

cards.ex: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
cards.exUz: Olimlar saraton kasalligini tadqiq qilishda katta yutuqqa erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Katta, muhim kashfiyot yoki yutuq.

cards.ex: I'm going to look into the latest research on climate change.
cards.exUz: Men iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha so'nggi tadqiqotlarni o'rganmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tekshirmoq yoki o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: It's too early to draw any firm conclusions from the study.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotdan qat'iy xulosalar chiqarishga hali erta.
cards.uzDef: Faktlardan yoki dalillardan xulosa yasamoq.

cards.ex: We have several new research projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi tadqiqot loyihalari rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ish jarayonida yoki tez orada amalga oshirilishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: The data set includes information on student performance and demographics.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar to'plami talabalarning ishlashi va demografiyasi haqidagi ma'lumotlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Tahlil uchun yig'ilgan ma'lumotlar to'plami.

cards.ex: The lab is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.
cards.exUz: Laboratoriya eng zamonaviy uskunalar bilan jihozlangan.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi va eng rivojlangan texnologiya yoki mahsulot.

cards.ex: The journal uses a rigorous peer review process to ensure quality.
cards.exUz: Jurnal sifatni ta'minlash uchun qat'iy ekspert baholash jarayonidan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa ekspertlar tomonidan tadqiqotni baholash jarayoni.

cards.ex: Her groundbreaking research changed the way we understand the brain.
cards.exUz: Uning innovatsion tadqiqoti miyani tushunishimizni o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va muhim g'oyalarni olib keluvchi tadqiqot.

cards.ex: We need to carefully consider the ethical considerations of this study.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu tadqiqotning axloqiy jihatlarini diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqotda axloqiy me'yorlarga rioya qilish masalalari.

cards.ex: The initial results suggest we're on the right track with our experiment.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki natijalar bizning tajribamizda to'g'ri yo'lda ekanligimizni ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilishda yoki maqsadga erishishda to'g'ri yo'nalishda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The study's findings suggest a link between diet and health.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot natijalari dieta va salomatlik o'rtasida bog'liqlik borligini ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot yoki tekshiruv natijasida olingan ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: Let's dig into the data and see what we can find.
cards.exUz: Keling, ma'lumotlarni chuqurroq o'rganib, nima topishimizni ko'raylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani chuqurroq o'rganish, tekshirish.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Ushbu muammoni hal qilish uchun standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, ijodiy va odatiy bo'lmagan usullarda fikrlash.

cards.ex: We've hit a wall in our research and need to find a new approach.
cards.exUz: Biz tadqiqotimizda tutilib qoldik va yangi yondashuv topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishda to'xtab qolish.

cards.ex: All research is subject to ethical guidelines.
cards.exUz: Barcha tadqiqotlar axloqiy me'yorlarga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Nimadidir ta'sirida bo'lish, nimagadir bog'liq bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new study builds on previous research in the field.
cards.exUz: Yangi tadqiqot ushbu sohadagi oldingi tadqiqotlarga asoslanadi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi yutuqlarga yoki bilimlarga asoslanib rivojlanish.

cards.ex: She works at the leading edge of artificial intelligence research.
cards.exUz: U sun'iy intellekt tadqiqotining eng oldingi qatorida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi yutuqlar va innovatsiyalar bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: We need to develop a proof of concept before we can get funding.
cards.exUz: Biz mablag 'olishimizdan oldin konsepsiyaning isbotini ishlab chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: G'oyaning amalga oshirilishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadigan dalil.

cards.ex: The initial trials yielded inconclusive results.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki sinovlar aniq bo'lmagan natijalar berdi.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlik kiritish uchun etarli bo'lmagan natijalar.

cards.ex: The scope of the study is limited to urban areas.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot doirasi shahar hududlari bilan cheklangan.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot qamrab oladigan mavzu yoki hudud.

cards.ex: The cost of the project is a ballpark figure of $1 million.
cards.exUz: Loyiha qiymati taxminan 1 million dollar.
cards.uzDef: Taxminiy, aniq bo'lmagan raqam.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Reja ishlamay qolganda, uni qayta ko'rib chiqish va boshidan boshlash.

cards.ex: The methodology used in the study was clearly explained.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotda qo'llanilgan metodologiya aniq tushuntirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot o'tkazish usullari va tamoyillari.

cards.ex: The research is under scrutiny because of potential bias.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot potentsial xatolik tufayli nazorat ostida.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan tekshirilmoqda yoki tanqid qilinmoqda.

cards.ex: Can you explain that in layman's terms?
cards.exUz: Buni soddalashtirilgan tilda tushuntira olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Mutaxassis bo'lmaganlar tushunishi uchun soddalashtirilgan tarzda.

cards.ex: This research uses cutting-edge technology.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tadqiqot eng zamonaviy texnologiyalardan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi va rivojlangan.

cards.ex: Down the line, this research could save lives.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda bu tadqiqot hayotni saqlab qolishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, keyinroq.

cards.ex: We need more empirical evidence to support this theory.
cards.exUz: Ushbu nazariyani qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun bizga ko'proq empirik dalillar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tajriba yoki kuzatuv orqali olingan dalil.

cards.ex: Ethics are the cornerstone of scientific research.
cards.exUz: Axloq - ilmiy tadqiqotning asosiy tamoyili.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning muhim asosi yoki tamoyili.
